Purpose: Authorization change-control governance. Defines valid state transitions, audit requirements, and direct-transition prohibitions. Current state: NoGo.

ValidTransitions.Requires: Explicit human approval artifact appears at expected path
All 14 validation rules pass, 15 rejection reasons cleared
Static scan clean, quarantine cleared, generator parity preserved, runtime/package/vector invariants confirmed

ForbiddenTransitions.Reason: Direct NoGo->Implementation is structurally forbidden. Must pass through ReviewPending -> ValidatedApproval -> GoCandidate.
Ready flags are NEVER equal to Approved/Go. See V16.18 DoNotMisinterpret.
V16.18 boundary frozen at ReadyButNotApproved. Requires human approval artifact.

ChangeControlRequirements: Every transition requires a change-control record with timestamp
Before/after invariant audit: RuntimeInfluenceAllowed, PackageOutputChanged, VectorBindingChanged must remain false
Generator parity must be preserved across transition
Static scan must be clean (zero disallowed matches)
Explicit human approval artifact must exist and validate
